crops.verdict_body_zh: 供给扎实、正确、有内在张力，但有一个规范缺位：非虚构的思想史 / AI 反思轴完全缺席；战争见证缺席（可接受为「延迟」）。
crops.verdict_body_en: A solid, correct, internally-tensioned list — but one canonical corner is absent: the nonfiction thought-history / AI-reflection axis; war testimony is also absent (acceptable as 'deferred').
